label: Kennedy exposes corruption in the FDA and the food industry
description: An instruction to intercede for Kennedy because attacks are coming against him over the freedom he wants to bring to the FDA and the food industry, exposing a worldwide network that started in America and ran into Europe and Asia, poisoning people through food and the environment to depopulate. He adds that not everything about the man is good. Given 1 December 2024.
aliases: the fda and the food industry
tentacles for corruption of poisoning people

label: Cures held back for years are released
description: A declaration that treatments known and held for a long time will be released, the sea parted over them and the blockage at the FDA removed, so that what has been withheld comes out.
aliases: they've had a cure for a long time
a releasing of all the things that have been blocked

label: Light in Goshen while darkness covers Egypt
description: Two things running at once: great financial blessing on the remnant, and financial torment and a felt darkness on everyone else, given as a type of the plagues where Israel had light in Goshen and Egypt had darkness you could feel.
aliases: darkness so dark that you could feel it
light on the children of israel

label: The disappearance of Christians is explained as an alien abduction
description: In a vision of the aftermath: an object over New York, public talk of aliens, and a woman telling him the Christians are all gone because the aliens came and took them. He gives the alien conversation as one of the signs before the return.
aliases: the aliens came and took them

label: A change in Russia's government and Putin finding God
description: Prayer for a change in the Russian government and that Vladimir Putin would find God in a way that is strong, set against the claim that both sides believe themselves right and the real actor is the devil.

label: Something dark over England at the New Year countdown
description: Darkness seen over England during the New Year's Eve countdown at the end of 2024, paired with an uncovering over England, and prayed against ahead of time.
aliases: a very darkness something bad over england

label: A thick membrane covering America as it blesses Israel
description: A dome, described as a thick membrane, coming back over America as the nation aligns with and helps Israel, given with the blessing and cursing text and tied to the oil and wealth that follow.
aliases: a dome of like a covering again over america

label: The national debt is turned around
description: Numbers seen turning the national debt around, funded by oil and natural gas out of the Gulf of Mexico said to be enough to fund the world, alongside supernatural wisdom with cryptocurrency and Solomon type wealth.
aliases: turning the the natur the national debt around
